draft_entry.summary: SpaceX Super Intelligence LLC announces Grok Bot 1.0, dated November 11, 2026. The announcement reports added support for shared Team Bots in Slack, Microsoft Teams, and video calls, proactive task suggestions, and changes to browser use, document and presentation creation, and app connections. It states that Team Bots are available on Team and Enterprise plans and Meetings on Team, Enterprise, and Ultra plans. The announcement reports no benchmark results and links no system card, model card, usage policy, or paper.
